client_note: eval/probe clients used a keep-alive HTTPS transport and one MCP initialize per client (operator patch; the stock eval client opens a new TLS connection and re-initializes per call, ~800 ms overhead). Latencies are client-side from the owner's Mac, including ~95 ms WAN RTT.

mutation_check.method: hlm export of hlmemo-e2e as-of import end (2026-09-24T03:51:56Z, before any librarian job) vs after the full drain (05:30Z); plus librarian audit
mutation_check.items_added_after: 17 = operator's variant-B/C lessons (step 6), not the librarian
mutation_check.cross_project_note: 4 proposals pair a hlmemo-e2e item with an item of the real project `hlmemo` (device 21 holds grants on both); one is an action-tier, high-confidence, verifier-agreed version_close of a `hlmemo` item. Not applied (observer). The real project was not read or modified by the operator.

rates.concurrency: in_flight never exceeded 1 (sequential jobs, ~12-18 s each)

cost_usd.note: spend is one ledger for librarian+synthesis+risk judge; per-task split estimated from windows

rates.breaker: closed/idle throughout; fallback profile never used; 0 errors in librarian logs
rates.observer_log_applied: per-job 'applied' counts in the librarian log are version_signals placements only (the one observer write, D-058)

analysis.corpus_note: corpus-B spans are pinned at 82200ae; this import is the 9ea3cad tree via `hlm import` (section-level items, 363 items vs 91 whole-file items in the phase0 baseline). Titles '<heading> · <path>' were mapped to the path for source matching (operator wrapper; run_eval.py itself only splits on ' § ').

server_latency_probe.stock_eval_client_ms: ~950 per call (new TLS + SSL context per request, and re-initialize per call because the server is stateless: 3 HTTPS round trips per tool call)

synthesis_grading.method: operator graded every answered synthesis against the row's gold facts (correct = primary answer right and no false claim; partial = incomplete, no false claim; false_claim = at least one statement contradicts the gold/evidence). Two runs = two independent synthesis samples of the same 80 queries (drill-top does not affect synthesis).

weak_positive_accuracy.caveat: the fast path is scored by verbatim keys only (undercounts paraphrase); the synthesis is graded semantically; the synthesis only sees retrieved text, so a careful agent reading the same hits could extract the same answers

citations.note: 1 two-sentence span shares one trailing citation

synthesis_grading.false_claim_pattern: 3 of 5 answer the prior-value half of a temporal question with the current value (the whole-token support guard passes because that token is verbatim in the cited excerpt); 1 wrong identifier value; 1 off-topic paraphrase that does not answer the question
